rules.accepted_credit_types: AVMA; AVMA-accredited schools; federal/state/county veterinary associations and USDA; Compendium on Continuing Education for the Practicing Veterinarian, NOAH, VIN; RACE courses; other courses approved by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated: under 6 months licensed - none; 6-12 months - 6 h; 12-24 months - 12 h.
rules.alternatives: Written extension or exemption request (illness, absence, hardship) at least 60 days before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep a CE log and attendance proof; CE entered in the DELPROS CE tracker.
rules.notes: Board renewal page: licenses expire July 31 of even years; Rule 9.1 says biennially in odd years - year parity unclear, confirm with the Board. No online limit stated.
rules.rule_quote: During each full licensure renewal period between August 1 and July 31 even-numbered years (2020-2022, etc.), active licensees must complete: 24 hours approved CE for Veterinarians
